name: Internalisation Data Volume 1
definition: Aggregated values and volumes of internalised settlements instructions for a specific type of financial instruments, type of transaction, type of clients, and cash transfers.

Volume.name: Volume
Volume.definition: Specifies the aggregated volume of internalised settlement instructions, in terms of:|•	Failed transactions,|•	Settled transactions,|•	Total  transactions.

Value.name: Value
Value.definition: Specifies the aggregated value of internalised settlement instructions, in terms of:|•	Failed transactions,|•	Settled transactions,|•	Total  transactions,|•	Percentage rate.
